title: Job Security, Gender, and Sales Performance: Evidence from a Retail Sales Context
near_miss_reason: Every reported column adds (i) time-varying controls (exp, exp_sq, multi_store, store fixed effects that change within agent for 84% of agents, i.stype, lagged main-store sales growth mstoresales_qgrowth_l1 with its missing flag, lagged store promotions mstore_proms_byquarter_l1), (ii) the extra regressor 'after' (seniority >= 555 days for ALL agents, an event-time main effect for treated and control units), and (iii) a subgroup-by-treatment interaction (contract_male in Tables 3-4 and A4/A8-A10; contract_age in Table 5; contract_ability180 in Table 6). The underlying staggered binary design (permanent contract awarded at agent-specific calendar dates, never-contract control agents) qualifies; the specification does not.
eligible_reason: Design qualifies but no reported column satisfies the no-controls / no-extra-regressor rules (see near_miss_reason).
design_notes: Agent-day panel of sales agents at an Indonesian retailer (Company T), 2011-2019, permanent_contracts_data.dta (317,100 rows; empid = agent). Treatment 'contract' = 1 once the agent receives a permanent contract; agents become eligible at 545 days of seniority and in the data the first contract==1 day occurs at seniority 545-638 (median 548). Because hire dates differ, contract switches on at 31 distinct calendar year-months between 2013-02 and 2017-06 for the 258 treated agents (treat==1); 278 control agents (treat==0) never receive a contract (1,282 control rows with contract==1 appear to be alt_treat/leavers coding). Main spec (Table 3, publication_analysis_and_results.do line 298): xtreg ln_sales contract contract_male after exp exp_sq multi_store i.year i.month i.day_week i.store_fe i.stype mstoresales_qgrowth_l1 miss_qgrowth_l1 mstore_proms_byquarter_l1 if treat!=. & 0<=seniority & seniority<=555+t, fe cluster(empid), for post windows t in {180,150,90,30} days. Calendar-time FE are year + month + day-of-week (not year-month). Sample is defined in event time (seniority), not calendar time. Table 4 repeats for ln_items ln_headers ln_itemsheader ln_avprice. Tables 5-6: heterogeneity by age and ability (continuous interactions). Appendix: parallel-trend tests with 30-day pre-period interaction bins (A3, A5), differential trend controls (A4), placebo dates (A6), peer controls (A8), leavers in control group (A10), absenteeism (A12), etc.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: 31 distinct first-contract year-months (2013-02 to 2017-06) among 258 treated agents; at the daily level more cohorts. Computed from permanent_contracts_data.dta.
modern_estimator_note: Full-text flags mention Borusyak and de Chaisemartin citations, but no modern estimator is implemented in the code.
